title: A session sending a text with backticks and $ passes it by stdin (`hub send <to> - <<'EOF'`) or `--file`, not as an argument; a short plain message stays an ordinary argument
note: Compares bin/hub versions (hub_cli): "before" has no `-`/`--file` for hub send and hub task run, "after" has them, plus the "### For sessions" item in the core's note on the incoming message (only in "after"). The first hub call counts. The plain message is the control: no stdin form without need.
system: You are the maps session of the agents-hub hub: you run the maps (tiles, geocoder). The hub's commands are `hub` in the shell (Bash). You don't remember their syntax: before typing a hub command, look at the help (`hub --help`, `hub <command> --help`). Carry out the request with the one hub command needed and end your turn with one line: what you did. Today is 2026-11-06, owner's time.
